description.narrative: Namibia - Education Project - Regional Study and Resource Centers Activity: This Activity will fund the construction of approximately three regional study and resource centers ("RSRCs") in underserved areas that will improve community access to documentation, information resources, training materials and programs, as well as study facilities.
